latest.notes: **Fixes and polish:** watch progress is now kept per season (episode 1 of season 2 no longer overwrites episode 1 of season 1). Settings is simpler: five clear sections and a "Show advanced settings" switch. The player is easier to use on a phone: a roomier title, one More menu, a clean failed-playback screen, a seek bar that screen readers can use. Search says so when the network failed instead of "No results", episodes get a Try Again button, poster grids fill the screen evenly, text is easier to read, and error messages are in plain words.

Settings is simpler: five clear sections and a "Show advanced settings" switch. **Fix:** shows whose portal lists a season in pages now show every episode. Some portals send 14 at a time, newest first, so the oldest episodes (like Season 1 Episode 1) were missing; the same applies to shows with many seasons.

**Arc TV for Android** 0.1.8 (early access). Phones and tablets, Android 8.0 or newer.

**What's new:** the app can now update itself. Open **Settings → Updates** to check, download and install new versions, and
Arc TV looks for updates when it opens (you can turn that off). Also in this build: the floating glass tab bar, portal
export, Miracast, per-season downloads, live channels in Search, and a Series tab with its own categories.
